title: File:Utmb-eau.jpg
claims: The file description reads "Ravitaillement en eau sur trail" and the file name identifies it as a UTMB water station.
The photo shows a volunteer handing water at a table laid out with cups, with an Ultra-Trail logo visible on the volunteer's shirt.
The author is mako10 and the source is Flickr image IMGP0174.
The file is licensed CC BY 2.0.
The file page does not name the aid station or kilometre shown.
